content:
The **Floater Freezer Grenade** is a weapon in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wastelanders* update.

A grenade made from the harvested pus sac of a floater freezer, possessing powerful cryogenic capabilities, to the point of freezing the target and causing them reduced movement speed for 8 seconds. The grenade possesses a very small explosion radius, but a very large area of effect radius in which the secondary effect can activate.

The plan for the grenade can be bought from Mortimer for 150 at raider reputation rank Friendly.
